chunks: I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about a man who has intercourse with a beast, whether a sheep, a she-camel, or a cow,
He said: “He is to be flogged with a penalty short of the fixed hadd, then banished from his town to another; and they mentioned that the meat of that beast is forbidden, as is its milk.”

key_terms.يُجْلَدَ: to be flogged as a legal punishment

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a person who commits intercourse with an animal in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning intercourse with an animal, stating that the offender is to be punished and banished. It also states that the meat and milk of the animal involved are forbidden, reflecting the gravity of the act in Shia fiqh.
